items.question: What are the defining form and attributes of the sixth chakra?
premises: The sixth chakra is identified in the sequence.
This chakra is characterized as royal.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth chakra is a royal center distinguished by eight petals and a central pericarp.
uncertainties: The term rājānam may function as a descriptive epithet or a specific designation.
The syntactic role of cakraṃ depends on verbal context not provided in this unit.
items.plain_english: But the sixth chakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
